verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own event-driven automation. Events can trigger commands such as `formant.run_script`, and Formant events can fire webhooks to any HTTP endpoint. Marketing pages also claim automated incident response, monitoring workflows and orchestration that dispatches help automatically, backed by a durable command queue. However, the documentation is mostly one-line mentions, and its AI-driven task recommendations explicitly require human approval rather than running autonomously. missing for 10: scheduled/time-based automation, in-depth docs on building and managing event-triggered workflows, autonomous (non-human-approved) AI-driven actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
